title: File-to-object migration duplicates existing log records
description: Evidence: FileBorealStore.snapshot includes event-log records; storage-migrate writes that snapshot into ObjectDirBorealStore; object-store logging appends non-null event/operation changes again. Impact: migrating file-v2 to objects-v1 can duplicate logical event/operation history and inflate audit volume.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration preserves event/operation history without re-appending duplicate log entries, with a fixture containing existing events and operations.
